articleTitle: Configuration method of cross-domain MPLS VPN based on double MCE
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: There are some inherent defects in the traditional VPN technology, which makes many needs of customers unable to be met when networking, and the implementation is relatively complex. Dual MCE cross domain MPLS VPN connects CE devices to PE devices of multiple same service providers, solves the address space overlap problem of the traditional VPN technology, and enhances the redundancy of the network. Starting from the actual operator case, this paper analyzes the needs and configures OSPF, MPLS, BGP/mbgp, routing strategy and other complex protocols on the equipment. The experimental results show that this method can well solve the shortcomings of traditional VPN technology, and summarizes the general operation methods with the flow chart, which provides a reference for better configuration in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Data Interaction and System Integration of Heterogeneous Systems Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: At present, the mainstream DCOM and other middleware technologies cannot be used for the communication between heterogeneous systems. To solve this problem, a heterogeneous data interaction and integration scheme based on Cobra and WebService is proposed. Firstly, the overall framework combining WebService and XML file technology is designed. Then the data type mapping technology is used to integrate the data types of various data sources. At the same time, a platform independent and language independent middle layer is established to complete the encapsulation design of CORBA resource attributes and resources. Finally, we test the performance of such integration scheme through a data service component example. The experimental results show that the system can improve the utilization and coverage of heterogeneous data, which also has optimal performance and scalability

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of SYN Flooding Attack in Power SCADA System Based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: SYN flooding is one of the common ways of DoS attack in SCADA system of electric power, which poses a great threat to the security of electric power information network and attracts the attention of researchers. In this paper, the queuing theory model is used to model the SNY Flooding attack process, and the normal request queue and the attack request queue are regarded as two independent birth and death processes, and a simple solution method is proposed. The simulation results show that the formula for calculating the connection loss rate is simple and the time complexity is lower, which provides a new idea and method for analyzing DoS attacks.

articleTitle: Website Visual Communication Design Method Based on User Experience
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to improve the insufficient interaction design of individual website products and poor user satisfaction, a website visual communication design method based on user experience is proposed. This paper aims at improving the website user experience as the main line of research, and it summarizes the elements that need to be considered in web page design from the visual communication design. Then we extract the design elements from several large domestic business websites, construct the website emotion evaluation scale, and test its reliability and validity. Finally, taking the design process of a special website as an example, the specific implementation method of visual communication elements in the process of building the website is provided. The website test results show that this scheme makes the user experience more friendly and the interaction more smooth, which also improves the comfort and efficiency of user browsing.

articleTitle: Effect of Rainy Weather on Transmission Performance of FSO System using BPSK Modulation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Free-Space Optics (FSO) is one of the innovative techniques in the field of Wireless Communication, which can be applied to establish a link between the end clients and the fiber optic systems wherever wired fiber communication is infeasible. Rainy weather has a significant influence on the performance of free space optical link, which leads to the degradation of link transmission quality and even the signal loss. In this paper, we investigate the performance of a FSO link considering the deteriorations caused by rain. The transmission performance objectives such as bit error rate and quality factor of BPSK-FSO system are simulated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Design Of Nonsingular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Speed Controller For Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the accuracy of the control system decreases under the condition of loss of excitation fault of permanent magnet synchronous motor, a non-singular fast terminal sliding mode control (NFTSMC) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, Build a mathematical model of PMSM for demagnetization fault. Secondly, Design of NFTSMC controller based on speed loop, The extended state observer is used to monitor the change of flux linkage to improve the estimation accuracy of flux linkage, And feed it back to NFTSMC controller to realize fault-tolerant control of PMSM loss of excitation fault, The system response speed is improved while reducing the system buffeting. Finally, The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed NFTSMC algorithm are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Cruise Control of Hydrostatic Tractor Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Hydrostatic tractor is an agent tool of artificial intelligence mechanical transmission system. In order to improve the automatic control level of driving path in constant speed cruise of hydrostatic tractor, a constant speed cruise control method of hydrostatic tractor based on CAN bus control and kinematic parameter fusion analysis is proposed. The kinematic planning model of hydrostatic tractor moving in constant-speed cruise is constructed, the visual characteristic parameters of hydrostatic tractor moving in constant-speed cruise are extracted by the method of visual perception of unknown environment of hydrostatic tractor, and the path space parameters capture and obstacle avoidance parameters fitting of hydrostatic tractor moving in constant-speed cruise are realized by CAN bus learning and man-machine interface parameter fitting method. Using the method of fitting and tracking discrete points of driving trajectory, combined with path planning and visual parameter tracking and identification methods, the adaptive control and spatial movement planning design of driving path of hydrostatic transmission tractor in constant speed cruise are realized. The test results show that this method has strong environmental adaptability and high control robustness, and improves the accuracy of constant-speed cruise control of hydrostatic tractor.

articleTitle: Research on the application of cross-domain VPN technology based on MPLS BGP
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to support the exchange of VPN routing information between operators, it is necessary to extend the existing protocols and modify the MPLS VPN architecture to provide an interconnection model that is different from that provided by the basic MPLS VPN architecture, that is, the BGP-based cross-domain MPLS VPN so that routing prefix and label information can be traversed across the interoperator link.This paper introduces the conceptual model of MPLS VPN based on BGP, analyzes the working principle of MPLS BGP VPN in depth, and compares the current mainstream BGP-based three types (VPN-OptionA, VPNOptionB, and VPN-OptionC) from the aspects of data transmission methods, advantages and disadvantages. The cross-domain MPLS VPN solution, combined with the actual situation of the operator’s network, simulates the implementation of the MPLS BGP cross-domain VPN of VPNOptionC. The results show that the tunnel established by this method can effectively solve the address conflict, mutual access control and data isolation of different VPN users. It can better meet the needs of large-scale operator network cross-domain construction network.

articleTitle: Construction of Smart Campus Data Security Sharing Model with Blockhcain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: With the application of various sensors in smart campuses, the collection of massive situational awareness data has become the basis for the research and development of smart campus applications. Aiming at the problems that thejoint perception information of multiple sensor devices is concentrated on the central server, and the devices cannot master comprehensive perception information and information sharing security, this paper proposes smart campus situational data security sharing model based on blockchain technology. The campus situational awareness activity data, designed the perception data fusion processing algorithm, combined the blockchain technology with the scenario model, built a credible environment for situational awareness, provided distributed data storage, and completed intelligent collaboration with smart contracts. The experimental results show that the The model effectively reduces the redundancy of data transmitted in the network, reduces the energy consumption of network nodes, and realizes real-time perception of teacher and student activity data and information security sharing in the smart campus scenario.

articleTitle: Electricity Carbon Emission Trading Market Mechanism Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Since the establishment of a carbon emission allowance trading market for electricity to performed the carbon emission allowance trading is one of the optional ways to promote the low-carbon goals of China, this study proposes a ‘‘pan-bilateral’’ market mechanism for the electricity carbon rights trading by using the blockchain technology, and carries out the carbon rights trading with the ‘‘centralized declaration and matching, distributed matching and clearing The trading price of carbon rights with ‘‘centralized matching and unified clearing’’ is 255.31 yuan/t, and the actual trading carbon rights are 131.5 t. The seller’s actual trading volume only accounts for 50.63% of the total declared sales volume, and the buyer’s actual trading volume only accounts for 55.11% of the total declared purchase volume. Through the example analysis and system tests, the experimental results shows that the ‘‘pan-bilateral’’ trading mode proposed can bring benefits to the main body of carbon rights market, and the test efficiency can satisfy the demand of carbon rights trading in a certain range. The combination of’’pan-bilateral’’ market mechanism and blockchain technology provides the technical support of market and platform for the carbon rights trading, and reduce the market barriers and obstacles of carbon rights.

articleTitle: Mobile Robots Path Planning Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of unreachable target of robot in path planning, the repulsive field function is improved to solve the problem of excessive repulsive force of obstacles around the target point In order to solve the problem that robots are prone to fall into local minima, firstly, whether the robot falls into local minima is determined according to the judgment conditions. If the robot falls into local minima, the velocity variable is introduced to provide escape velocity for the robot. After judging that the robot escapes from local minima, the potential field is used again for path planning According to the complexity of obstacles, an adaptive step adjustment method is proposed to improve the efficiency of the robot and smooth the path planning, so that the robot can move forward smoothly and efficiently. Finally, MATLAB is used to carry out simulation experiments, and the results prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of Roadside Unit Coverage in Vehicular Ad Hoc Network Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of blind coverage and resource waste caused by overlapping coverage in roadside unit (RSU) coverage in Vehicle Ad-hoc Network (VANET), a roadside unit coverage optimization method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) was proposed in this paper. This method maximizes the network coverage with less RSUs on the premise of ensuring the service quality. Taking effective coverage of network as the optimization objective, particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with crossover strategy of genetic algorithm was adopted to avoid global falling into local optimum, and the influence of perception radius on coverage ability was analyzed in detail. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has some advantages in improving network coverage and effectively achieves global optimization of RSU layout in Vehicle Ad Hoc Network.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on PSO-VMD
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To address the problem that the number of decomposition layers K and penalty factor a in variational modal decomposition (VMD) have a great influence on the accuracy of the decomposition results, a method is proposed to determine the optimal values of K and a using particle swarm optimization (PSO). In addition, a correlation analysis method is used to quantify the correlation between each component decomposed by VMD and the original signal of the fault, which helps to find the IMF component with more fault information among all IMF components. Finally, the simulation signal and experimental data of rolling bearing inner ring faults are analyzed and diagnosed respectively to verify the effectiveness of the PSO-VMD fault diagnosis method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Pilot Assignment Method Based on Time-shifting and Space-Division in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To overcome the pilot pollution of large-scale multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems caused by the repeated use of pilots in adjacent cells, a pilot assignment method based on time-shifting and space-division is proposed. Then, channel estimation error is analyzed. We derive the closed expression of the uplink and downlink rates to investigate the performance of the proposed scheme. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can mitigate pilot contamination greatly and improve system performance.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application and Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Processing Technology in Interior Design
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to further improve and ensure the quality of interior design program, this paper puts forward an evaluation method of interior design program based on artificial intelligence processing technology. The indoor environmental quality indexes in interior design program are compared, and a perfect evaluation system is established, and a better interior design program can be obtained with the help of artificial intelligence processing technology.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Illegal Registered Account Behavior Based on GNN
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at a large number of illegal account registration behaviors, this paper proposes a group detection method based on graph neural network technology, which uses the account registration data of targge, a social platform published on GitHub, including the isomorphism of account behavior, registered account activity, number of posts, etc., to obtain the node sequence of users from multiple perspectives, and generate the user feature vector, Then, the graph neural network model is used to train the model according to the account registration data of the candidate group, and finally the graph neural network model with topology and behavior characteristics as input learning is obtained. Finally, for the method proposed in this paper, the targge account registration data set is used to verify the data set, and the comparison with the existing algorithms shows that, The performance of the algorithm proposed in this paper on targge data sets is generally better than the two traditional classifiers, namely, boosted trees classifier and random forest classifier. It can effectively detect the behavior of illegally registered accounts.

articleTitle: Design of high-precision two-axis eccentric adjustment experimental platform based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To overcome the axial inconsistency between the motion output mechanism and the work object in the field of machining, a high-precision two-axis eccentric adjustment experimental platform is designed in this paper with the modular design method. Precise control of two-degree-offreedom motion output for rotation angle and feed depth can be realized controlled by the host computer software LabVIEW. The experimental results show that the motion of the experimental platform is stable and reliable, and the motion output mechanism has the function of eccentric adjustment, which has the precision of the feeding depth of 1 μm, the eccentric adjustment range of ±5 mm, and the eccentric adjustment accuracy of 10 μm.

articleTitle: Nested Composite Ring Microstrip Multi Frequency Antenna for Beidou Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: This paper presents a miniaturized nested composite ring microstrip multi frequency antenna which is suitable for navigation terminal by using similar structure nesting. The antenna is affected by the number of nested rings, the width of nested ring arm, the distance between nested rings and other factors, and can design single frequency, dual frequency or multi frequency microstrip antennas for different purposes according to different needs. The width of the nested loop arm can adjust the dual frequency resonant frequency points, and the distance between the nested loops can increase the high /1ow frequency ratio of the antenna. Loading coupling holes on the nested loop arm can not only adjust the resonant frequency of high frequency, but also further expand the frequency ratio to obtain microstrip antennas with different requirements. Through the comprehensive use and research of the above technologies, dual band microstrip antennas with frequency points of 1.6 GHz and 2.5 GHz are obtained. The size of the antenna is reduced by 50% compared with the general microstrip antenna, and meets the requirements of Beidou navigation system for terminal antenna.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Dormitory Management System Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent dormitory management system which design based on the Raspberry Pi, face++ cloud service platform and a variety of sensors, the system has been designed and realized using the Raspberry Pi as the controller. Taking the face++ cloud service platform as a module, User identification is implemented and access control is realized, Using the temperature and humidity sensor monitors the indoor temperature in real time, automatically turns on and off the air conditioner, which can provide a comfortable environment for students, at the same time, Using MQ-2 sensor to detect cigarette smoke, The system will sound the alarm if smoke is detected, it can effectively reduce indoor smoking among students. And to ensure the safety of students. The system further improves the comfort and safety of the dormitory, and has certain practical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Remote Nursing Monitoring APP Based on WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To make more rational use of medical resources and WSN system and improve the efficiency of nursing service, we adopt Zibee technology to establish WSN network nodes and complete the corresponding system design scheme. The sensor technology is integrated with Zigbee to construct a wireless sensor monitoring network architecture. Then, TI’s CC2530 chip is used as the main control chip to run the ZigBee protocol stack. The corresponding sensor modules are used to collect the data of human posture, pulse and body temperature. Then the software design is based on Android platform, and the overall process of APP design by JSP is also provided. The system test results show that the remote nursing monitoring APP can display the physiological parameters of the monitored object in real time and intuitively, which provides users with health examination intelligent diagnosis and related services.

articleTitle: Abnormal Access Identification of Network Information Based on Multimodal Data Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more information is disseminated and stored through the Internet, which makes network security issues more and more people’s attention. In such an environment, the research on network security gradually develops and presents a thriving development trend. The purpose of this paper is to design and develop an abnormal access recognition platform for network information based on the background of multimodal data flow. Firstly, according to the characteristics of information in the network security management system, the multi-source multi-modal data analysis algorithm is selected as the abnormal traffic detection method. Next, the system design is carried out, the data acquisition module uses tcpdump to realize the acquisition of information data in the network. Anomaly detection module adopts multi-source and multi-modal data analysis algorithm to complete anomaly identification. Finally, the practicability and detection ability of the system are evaluated, that is, it is compared and analyzed with big data technology and BP neural network model. 50 experiments were carried out for each algorithm. The test results show that the detection rate of abnormal access recognition of network information designed in this paper is 94.25% and the accuracy rate is 93.09%, which are higher than the other two models, with a false detection rate of 4.29% and a missed detection rate of 2.49%, which are lower than the other two models. Therefore, compared with big data technology and BP neural network model, the multi-source multi-modal data analysis algorithm designed in this paper has better performance in identifying abnormal access to network information.

articleTitle: Design of An Amplifier Nonlinear Distortion Experimental Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: A multi-stage amplifier circuit composed of transistors is designed in the amplifier nonlinear distortion experimental equipment, which can generate five different distortion signals including top distortion through control. The single-chip microcomputer (stm32fl03vet6) is used as the controller to generate five different distortion signals through two-stage common emission amplifier circuit and one-stage Output Capacitor Less(OCL) power amplifier circuit. The signal is collected through the ADC provided by the singlechip microcomputer, The distortion signal is processed and calculated by Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). Finally, the parameters such as voltage peak to peak(Vp-p) and total harmonic distortion(THD) of the distortion signal are displayed by TFT LCD screen to realize accurate measurement of the nonlinear distortion related parameters of the distortion signal.

articleTitle: Secure encryption method for communication sensitive information based on multi-source information fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Traditional communication information encryption methods have problems such as low encryption efficiency and poor integrity of information encryption. Therefore, this paper proposes a secure communication sensitive information encryption method based on multi-source information fusion. Firstly, the structure level of multi-source information fusion is analyzed, and the sensitive communication information is collected by data collector and encrypted for secondary processing. Secondly, information fusion between multiple communication sensitive information is realized through Dempster combination rules. Finally, the similarity matrix is constructed, the support degree is calculated by information entropy, the output characteristic quantity of communication sensitive information encryption is obtained by key check, and the secure encryption function of communication sensitive information is obtained by circular shift method to achieve secure encryption of communication sensitive information. Experimental results show that when the amount of communication sensitive information data is 200GB, the encryption time of the proposed method is 0. 98s, and the noise intensity is 90dB, the encryption integrity of the proposed method is 96%. The results show that the proposed method has high security and efficiency in communication sensitive information encryption.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Scheduling Strategy of Controllable Load Access Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To solve the grid-connected dispatch problems of controllable load under the development of distributed power transaction mechanism, a decentralized transaction mode between controllable load users and load agents based on blockchain technology is proposed. By integrating the operation characteristics of controllable load users and fully considering the demand information of electricity purchase and sales between different sub-categories of users and load agents, two types of decision model functions of controllable load users and load agents are designed. Based on the basic principle of best interest, the blockchain node model is established considering operation and maintenance cost and operation efficiency. The simulation analysis of 500,000 residents in a central city on a typical summer day shows that the penetration rate of electric vehicles is 20% and that of air conditioners is 30% by assuming that the electricity price of the load agent selling electricity to the power grid is 0.5 yuan/(kWh), the unit damage cost of the electric vehicle power battery is 0.14 yuan/(kWh), and the agency fee of a single electric vehicle user is 0.1 yuan/d. The analysis results of an example show that the proposed optimal dispatch strategy fully taps the potential of controllable load users and load agents for peak load shifting of power grid, achieves economic optimization for both parties, and guarantees the long-term effective operation of blockchain network, thus providing reference value for the application of blockchain technology in power demand response.

articleTitle: Distributed Collection Method of Economic Growth Data Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: First of all, according to the actual data collection scene, combined with the advantages and disadvantages of the existing detector framework, the overall architecture of the distributed data collection system is proposed, and it is divided into three parts: web management side, server side, collection side. Secondly, on the basis of the above design, the development language is based on Python, and then the acquisition system is developed on the cloud platform in the laboratory, and a detailed test is carried out for the real field. Finally, use the website as a source for collecting data. This website contains two types of anti-tracking measures: IP Restriction and Referral Restriction. The number of pages successfully collected is counted every 10 minutes. The experimental results show that the number of pages that are not successfully requested by the download middleware does not increase since the acquisition system starts from 20 minutes. For the collection node that triggers the download of the middleware, the dynamic IP proxy setting is enabled, so even if the collection can be resumed after 30 minutes, accessing the data source through the proxy server will undoubtedly increase the network delay. Therefore, downloading middleware has a significant impact on setting reference restrictions, IP blocking, etc.

articleTitle: Design of Information Linkage Alarm System Based on Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: system is used independently, for sudden emergencies, the traditional security protection system can…. t inform the staff relevant situations comprehensively and automatically. It is not conductive for the staff to catch early warning and handle emergency events. Meanwhile, the management of independent subsystems is complicated. So, establishment of a unified management and control platform is proposed to integrate sorts of information. The paper elaborates information integration architecture based on video surveillance, supporting technologies and linkage application functions. By establishing logical relationship, all subsystems are integrated into a united and interactive security protection system which has the ability of automatic identification, automatic forecasting and processing. It reflects the economic philosophy that equipment utilization maximization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Live APP for College Students Education Based on J2EE and Objective-C
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To change all kinds of defects existing in current network learning system, this paper considers the actual demand analysis of ideological and political education, designs and implements a live teaching APP for college students’ education. The system is developed based on IOS platform, using Objective-C language, and optimizing the user experience under the premise of low configuration. We combined the technology of big data recommendation system and mainstream media of mainstream live broadcasting platform to decompose the functional modules of the project. Then, for certain key modules, the core logic of key technologies is presented. Finally, the system is implemented and tested on the mobile platform. The results show that such APP can achieve dynamic and efficient push of college students’ ideological and political learning resources, and provide flexible live interactive function to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electronic Communication System Bus Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of current electronic bus data communication system in transmission rate, real-time performance and anti-interference ability, a bus data communication system based on DSP is proposed. We mainly introduce the new characteristics of TMS320F2812 DSP controller, and make communication between CAN modules through this chip. Then, combined with the actual design and implementation of software and hardware, the system test platform is established, and the corresponding programming and transplantation process are provided. The system debugging results show that the bus system has high reliability and speed of data conversion, simple hardware circuit design and software programming, which can effectively transmit and store the acquired data.

articleTitle: Research on CTI Voice Service Automatic Processing Technology for Logistics Scheduling Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To meet the scheduling requirements and business processes of logistics service center system construction, the implementation and design idea of logistics information system innovation based on CTI technology are proposed. Based on the availability analysis of the call processing function of logistics system, this paper designs the framework of voice business integrated processing system with CTI technology as the core. Then, the automatic voice response system of the system is realized in a multi-threaded manner, and the business functions of each key module of call center service are realized by comprehensively using ACD, IVR, SCADA, GPS and related technologies. At the same time, combined with the layered design idea, the load balancing strategy is adopted to complete the allocation of manual seats. The system test results show that the CTI application platform has high stability, high integration, high cost performance, and it can better meet the demand of practical applications for logistics communication scheduling.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction of Health Industry Project Based on FCE Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In view of the financing situation and problems of various sub sectors of the medical and health industry, a health industry project risk prediction scheme based on FCE algorithm is proposed. Taking the venture capital project of a large health industrial park as an example, we established corresponding risk index system from the characteristics of the health industry. Then, through the study of nonlinear evaluation model, the calculation process of FCE in project evaluation is changed. According to the establishment of specific fuzzy matrix, the computation of index weight and the output of comprehensive weight evaluation results, the final ranking of influencing index factors is obtained, to determine the risk structure of health industry projects. Finally, based on the composition and causes of each risk prediction, this paper puts forward countermeasures and suggestions to strengthen the risk management and innovate the financing mode of the medical and health industry.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Access Control System Based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the traditional access control system, such as inconvenient key management and low security performance, this paper designs a smart access control system based Wi-Fi. This smart access control system uses STM32F103C8T6 as the controller, which is mainly composed of ATK-AS608 fingerprint identification module, OLED display screen, 4*4 matrix key module and ESP8266 Wi-Fi module. The system can unlock through the fingerprint identification module and the 4*4 matrix key module. In addition, the system can add, delete, modify and check fingerprints. At the same time, the system can changing the password by the 4*4 matrix key module. When using fingerprint identification or password to unlock, if the number of failures exceeds 3 times, the buzzer will alarm. Besides, users can use the APP to unlock remotely through the password. The test results show that the design works stably, has high security, convenience and low cost.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Large Energy-saving Building Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the practical problems that the current energy-saving design methods cannot meet the actual needs, an energy-saving building simulation designing scheme based on BIM is put forward. This paper combines BIM technology with the analysis of architectural design environment, and makes full use of the parametric function of Revit family and NavisWorks model to jointly design an energy-saving building model, along with high visualization and simulation. Then the virtual simulation engine is introduced through BIM to simulate and analyze the wind environment, sunshine and lighting around the building. Finally, a specific project implementation of an energy-saving building is illustrated to test the effectiveness of this scheme. The experimental results show that the 3D simulation image of large-scale energy-saving buildings constructed by the design system has high definition, which overcomes the problem of low correlation between various indicators in the traditional analytical method of image modeling.

articleTitle: Financial Credential Asset Token under Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In this paper, the issue of financial credential asset tokens is studied in the context of blockchain technology. In order to solve the problems of large file storage and poor algorithm performance in current research on financial credential asset token, based on the blockchain technology, the data of the business system can be protected. Then, by packaging the contents of financial credentials into blocks, the malicious tampering of financial credentials by operators is effectively prevented. There are two innovations. First, by using electronic storage technology of financial credentials, which combines distributed file system and blockchain, the problem that each transaction message on the current blockchain is not suitable for carrying large file attachments can be solved. Second, a new algorithm CT-DPCFT is innovatively proposed to improve the performance of consensus algorithm. Thus, the financial credentials can be packaged on the chain in a lightweight manner, and consensus discrimination can be carried out efficiently at the business side. The experiment results show that CT-DPCFT can solve the problems of difficult storage of large files and poor algorithm performance of current financial credential asset tokens to some extent.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Piano Audio Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In recent years, the collective teaching mode of digital piano has gradually become a research hotspot of piano teaching.According to the actual use needs and the actual problems encountered in teaching, this paper provides a piano audio signal networking transmission scheme for the digital piano classroom, realizes the networking function of the digital piano collective classroom, provides a feasible operation platform for the digital piano collective teaching, and enables the digital piano collective teaching mode to be better developed and popularized. The bilinear transformation method is used to analyze and process the audio signal, and a suitable filter is designed to filter the noise and restore the original signal, so that the transmission of the audio signal is more stable.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Tourism Sustainable Development Ability Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to provide scientific basis for the improvement of tourism economic quality and green environmental protection, an evaluation method of tourism sustainable development ability based on neural network model is proposed. Firstly, by collecting and managing tourism resource information through investigation and analysis, an evaluation index system based on the main influencing factors of the sustainable development ability of tourism economy and tourism is constructed. Then the data standardization, training and output are performed based on BP neural network, and the comprehensive ranking of various indicators of sustainable development is acquired. Finally, according to the actual demand, MATLAB is adopted to verify the effectiveness of the evaluation scheme based on BP neural network. The experimental results show that it improves the sensitivity and reliability of the evaluation and early warning system, which provides new measures and ideas for the sustainable development of tourism economy.

articleTitle: Design of Campus Team Network Experiment Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Nowadays, many colleges and universities are advocating the training mode of driving and promoting students’ professional learning through scientific and technological innovation competitions. In this environment, various competitions emerge in endlessly, and the number of participants has doubled year by year. The competition has gradually become an important indicator for colleges and universities to evaluate the comprehensive quality of students. According to the questionnaire survey results collected, 58% of the students are faced with team formation problems, such as difficulty in finding a mentor, difficulty in recruiting, unbalanced team allocation and so on. This paper completes the analysis and design of the “Campus Partner” campus team-up network platform based on the situation of team-up in University competitions, which makes the participating students more efficient in the process of finding teammates, mentors or teams, and realizes the ability of team-mates and mutual assistance, and solves the problems existing in the needs of student team-up on campus.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Medical Robot Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Whenever a major public health event occurs, considering the huge demand for materials, heavy disinfection tasks, shortage of medical staff, and the risk of cross-infection, the paper uses genetic algorithm for global path planning to assist medical robots complete path planning and optimization in a static environment. Genetic algorithms can automatically acquire and accumulate knowledge about the search space during the search process, and adaptively control the search process to obtain the best solution. The paper takes the makeshift hospital map as the background, uses the grid method to establish the environment model, and uses the genetic algorithm to plan the path of the mobile medical robot. The experimental results show that an optimal path for a mobile medical robot with a short average path length and a smooth path can be finally obtained.

articleTitle: An Optimization Scheme for Enterprise Financial Management Informatization Construction Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to comprehensively improve the accounting informatization level of enterprises, the construction mode and optimization path of enterprise financial management informatization under the cloud computing environment are studied systematically. This paper discusses the objectives and principles of establishing cloud computing accounting information system, and puts forward the system logical architecture, physical architecture and database construction method under SaaS mode. Then it provides the optimization process of enterprise financial informatization construction. Finally, by using the scheme for empirical analysis, it is proved that our cloud service model can reduce business risks in financial management, and improve the quality and efficiency of enterprise integrated management greatly.

articleTitle: Augmented extended nested array configuration for consecutive degrees of freedom enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: With the increasing demand of the accuracy of direction of arrival (DOA) estimation, the spare array configurations have attracted considerable interest because of their ability of possessing increased array aperture and enhanced degrees of freedom (DOF). In this paper, we propose an augmented extended nested array (AENA) strategy based on the different co-array (DCA) theory. The AENA configuration consists of a sparse uniform linear array (ULA) and two sparse nonuniform linear arrays (NLAs) with sensor locations being determined by relative position. Compared with other existing sparse arrays, the significant advantage of AENA configuration is its ability of processing a higher number of consecutive DOF. And simulation results have confirmed the superiority that our proposed AENA configuration can furtherly reduce the root mean square error (RMSE) in DOA estimation, compared with the other nested-like array configurations.

articleTitle: Network Detection Platform Based on iMaster-NCE
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of finding problems in traditional network operation and maintenance, unable to quickly locate the source of the problem, and unable to comprehensively analyze the health index and data of the problem equipment, this paper proposes to design a network detection platform in the form of web based on iMaster-NCE. Through the SDN network architecture iMaster-NCE Campus API, the data is obtained, processed and analyzed, and the processed and analyzed data is displayed in the form of visual charts, which can help the network operation and maintenance personnel accurately and quickly locate network problems, save a lot of time, and improve the efficiency of network operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Design of Short-Wave Voice Signal Detection Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Under the condition of short-wave variable parameter channel, the accuracy rate of common Voice Activity Detection method always need to improve because of the influence of low signal-to-noise ratio and complex environmental noise. With the rise of artificial intelligence (AI), signal recognition which is based on statistical machine learning theory of artificial neural networks, is gradually becoming the main direction of signal recognition areas. A short-wave speech signal detection platform is designed in this article, it can finish the better short-wave speech signal detection even under low SNR (signal-to-noise ratio), and it can give the time segmentation of the speech signal.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Building Equipment Remote Monitoring Platform Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to realize the visualization and data integration of building equipment monitoring data, a remote monitoring platform and visual management system based on BIM are designed. Combined with the actual engineering needs of the current building monitoring field, we have established the overall architecture of the remote monitoring system based on BIM. Then we study the methods of monitoring data acquisition, management and storage using sensors and databases, and realize the display and partial information integration of BIM model based on IFC standard for the client. Finally, the network programming language and MySQL database are used for data visualization and web output. The system test results show that our scheme realizes the efficient and visual management of the operation and maintenance stage of construction equipment, and it also makes the operation and maintenance work more advanced and controllable.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Call Center Service System Based on CTI
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to call enterprise resources efficiently and respond to customer needs quickly and normatively, a customer service center system based on CTI technology is designed. This paper introduces the system composition and main functions of the call center based on CTI technology, and improves the design in terms of architecture and business content, as well as the specific software and hardware composition. Then the KEY components of call center such as ACD, CTI, IVR are analyzed, and the specific design and implementation process are also provided. For the Web terminal business of the system, it puts forward a detailed solution for class structure diagram, C# realization and so on. Finally, a detailed test of each functional module of the call center is performed to ensure that the call center system can be successfully used online in the current network, and the service quality is also greatly improved.

articleTitle: A novel scheme of data consistency in distributed controller deployment for SDON
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Data consistency is an important research issue in the deployment of SDON distributed controller. The core of solving data consistency problem is distributed lock. At present, data consistency scheme based on ZooKeeper is the mainstream. In order to find a better solution, this paper implements the data consistency scheme of distributed controller based on Redis and ZooKeeper, and makes a comparative analysis. The results show that taking the time of acquiring the whole network topology and the single flow table as the performance evaluation index of the data consistency scheme, when acquiring the whole network topology, Redis is 25.0 % faster than ZooKeeper, and when acquiring the single flow table, Redis is 40.1 % faster than ZooKeeper.

articleTitle: Convolutional neural network-based channel allocation and resource optimization for D2D communications
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In mobile communication systems, D2D techniques can significantly improve the throughput of the system. To overcome the problem that the sharing of spectrum resources in cellular networks can cause link interference between cellular and D2D users resulting in difficult resource allocation, this paper constructs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to approximate the traditional optimization method, which takes into account various constraints such as optimal system performance, minimizing interference and satisfying the minimum quality of service for users, satisfying the upper and lower power requirements as well as the demand variability. Experimental results show that the proposed adaptive approach is suitable for complex multi-cell scenarios, with a practical efficiency of around 1.5 times the original efficiency and low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Improvement of Spectral Afterglow Mapping Method Based on Density Inhomogeneity
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Radio spectrum monitoring and spectrum data analysis are important means of radio management. Spectrum visualization technology plays an important role in spectrum data analysis. Afterglow map is a new type of spectrum visualization technology. It superimposes the time window of multiple frames of spectrum, which can make the transient signal show a slow disappearance effect in the afterglow map, and the afterglow map can also be persistently captured for a period of time. Signals in the full spectrum, giving the user a complete overview. In this paper, the new afterglow color mapping method is discussed, and the traditional linear uniform mapping method of afterglow color is improved to a nonlinear mapping based on non-uniform density characteristics. By using real data sets to compare and analyze the experimental results, the experiments show that the new mapping method can effectively improve Color utilization and visual resolution.

articleTitle: Dynamic Spectrum Allocation for Drone Swarm with Auction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to relieve spectrum shortage in drone swarm, a novel dynamic spectrum allocation algorithm based on cooperation sensing and auction is given. Different from existing work, the novel algorithm is decentralized in that sensing fusion and auction are carried by all swarm members. Spectrum allocation is solved quickly with dynamic programming. At the same time, spectrum supply and demand are balanced by dual price adjustment. Simulation results show that new allocation has good performance of spectrum utilization and auction revenue.

articleTitle: Design of college digital enrollment System based on big data platform in digital communication era
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: The traditional college digital enrollment system has some problems such as low throughput rate and long information processing time. Therefore, this paper designs a college digital enrollment system based on big data platform in the digital communication era. Through data mining method to collect data of university students, the use of secondary structure for college student data format conversion, according to the source data to data cleaning, based on average method added to achieve data conversion, college student admissions grades obtained through discretization process analysis, to build grey model of digital recruitment of students information management in institutions of higher education. The experimental results show that the information processing time of the college digital enrollment system is only 5. 0s, and the throughput rate of the college digital enrollment system is 59. 8b/s, indicating that the system has superior performance.

articleTitle: Distributed Authentication Method for Power Grid Based on Consortium Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the problem of network security has become increasingly prominent. The State Grid is a mega-enterprise that is the lifeblood of the national economy and national energy security, the security of State Grid has been highly valued by all sectors of society. However, traditional grid identity systems face serious security threats due to their centralised structure. Based on the consortium blockchain technology, this paper proposes a decentralized distributed authentication method to provide user authentication services for the application system. Relying on smart contracts and consensus mechanisms, the information stored…. in the authentication system is associated with the application system, and the users can perform corresponding operations after obtaining permissions. This method can effectively drive data sharing, promote information circulation. Change the traditional identity verification method, and solve the problems of transaction centralization, authentication server failure, and untraceable data traceability while safeguarding system security. Finally, this paper designs and implements the self-control of user identity and authentication method of trusted access based on the consortium blockchain network, which provides technical support for the security of national power system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Monitoring Technology of Substation Equipment Based on Power IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of current traditional substation equipment monitoring devices are independent of each other, and the interaction between equipment and system is poor, an intelligent monitoring sensor network based on the Internet of things(IoT) is designed. According to the functional requirements analysis, the IoT architecture of power transmission and transformation equipment, including intelligent perception layer and data communication layer is proposed. Then it discusses the key technologies involved in the system, such as hardware composition, sensor design, database connection, visual interface and so on. At the same time, the data transmission and networking process in the monitoring system is designed, and the typical intelligent application schemes of each subsystem are described. The system test results based on the case analysis show that this design scheme meets the requirements of automatic control, intelligent regulation and coordinated linkage of the intelligent substation auxiliary production system, and uploads the equipment monitoring data that may have faults to the central station, effectively avoiding the occurrence of power accidents.

articleTitle: An Orchestral Style Recognition Approach Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low style recognition rate of traditional music recognition model, this paper takes orchestral music as an example and proposes a music style recognition method based on deep learning. During the preprocessing, the program adopts the technologies such as track splicing to obtain music features. Then the music recognition and classification algorithm based on RNN is studied, and it is improved by bidirectional GRU. Finally, through the processing of musical instrument samples and the extraction of Mel frequency Cepstrum coefficient, the trained model is acquired for the simulation experiment of style recognition. The test results show that the style recognition method proposed in this paper has a high recognition rate, and it also has better comprehensive performance compared with similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Path planning optimization of medical service robots based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that medical service robots can better plan their driving paths indoors, the paper proposes to use particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm for path planning, so that mobile robots can smoothly avoid static obstacles and complete feasible paths. Experimental results show that the proposed method reasonably plans the path and realizes the optimal solution.

articleTitle: Time Sensitive Network Switching Scheduling for Multimodal Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Time sensitive Networking (TSN) is an industrial network technology being actively promoted by the industry at present. It is one of the most promising technologies to ensure the real-time and deterministic transmission of information in industrial production. This paper mainly focuses on time sensitive network switching scheduling for multimodal networks. First of all, it introduces the relevant protocol standards of time sensitive networks, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of different protocols. This paper improves the gated scheduling algorithm on the gated scheduling mechanism of IEEE 802.1qbv protocol, and makes an in-depth study on the scale gated scheduling algorithm from the exploration of optimization objectives, mathematical models, algorithm design and implementation. The experimental results show that the scale gated scheduling algorithm optimized in this paper has excellent performance.

articleTitle: A method of heterogeneous network information data integration based on XML Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: The traditional network information data integration methods have the problems of low data integration efficiency and poor integration accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes a heterogeneous network information data integration method based on XML technology. Firstly, the basic meaning of XML technology is analyzed, and the file global security hash function is constructed according to the XML structure to determine the input plaintext space of heterogeneous networks; Secondly, the file identifier is determined, and the spatial information of XML ciphertext data is retrieved according to the file identifier; Then, the retrieval results are sorted according to the relevance, the heterogeneous network information data feedback results are obtained, the Fc-Sae model is constructed, the tokenizer word breaker is used to segment the heterogeneous network information, the heterogeneous network information matrix features are extracted, the historical average method is used to obtain the heterogeneous network data trends, and the heterogeneous network data features are integrated through the SAE model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of heterogeneous network information data integration of this method is up to 99.9%, and the time of heterogeneous network information data integration is only 4. 3s, indicating that the efficiency of heterogeneous network information data integration is high.

articleTitle: Visual obstacle avoidance method of manipulator based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that most industrial robots are unable to avoid obstacles independently in the working environment, a robot arm obstacle avoidance method based on ROS (robot operating platform) and guided by Kinect camera is proposed. Firstly, the robot model is established by using URDF file in ROS, and the kinematics configuration of the model is carried out; After that, the principle of camera calibration is analyzed, the internal and external parameters of the camera are calibrated, and then the hand eye matrix of the robot and the camera is obtained and the error is verified to provide support for visual obstacle avoidance; Finally, the physical simulation environment gazebo and Rviz are built for joint simulation. Obstacles are placed in gazebo. Kinect camera converts the obstacle point cloud data into Octomap map in real time and outputs it to Rviz visualization platform. The running program can see that the visualization platform controls the robot arm in the physical environment to carry out obstacle avoidance planning. The experimental results show that the robot arm guided by Kinect camera based on ROS platform can accurately carry out obstacle avoidance planning, which has reference significance for the application research of robot under ROS.

articleTitle: Sensitive Information Recognition Method based on Deep Learning in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet, the total amount of network information has not only increased significantly, but also its communication channels have been gradually broadened. The diversification of channels makes the dissemination of information change from one-way to multi-way, and leads to more sensitive information disclosure in the process of dissemination. This paper mainly studies the sensitive information recognition method of online social networks based on deep learning. In this paper, the mobile phone has constructed the network sensitive message perception framework, analyzed the perception influence factors, and selected the text information as the research object. In this paper, CRNN is used as the framework of perceptual information model. The convolutional neural network part of the network model is composed of seven layers of convolution layer and four layers of pooling layer, and two layers of bidirectional LSTM. In this paper, the proposed CRNN framework is used to carry out simulation experiments, and the experimental results are compared with the other two algorithm frameworks. Through the experimental results, we can know that the CRNN algorithm used in this paper has the advantages of improving the utilization of feature information and efficient transmission of feature information.

articleTitle: Encryption Algorithm of Distributed Ledger in Engineering Settlement Application
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In this paper, an encryption algorithm of distributed ledger is proposed in engineering settlement application. In order to solve the problems of unclear settlement objectives in each stage, complex and variable financial operation process, and leakage of important information data transmission, by applying distributed ledger technology to traditional engineering settlement, and optimizing the encryption module, all stages of settlement are made transparent, the efficiency of settlement is improved, and information security can be ensured. The experimental results show that the optimized encryption module can solve the key transport security problem in the symmetric encryption algorithm. It can ensure the password encryption speed and transport security. Meanwhile, the network information security is greatly increased in the construction settlement.

articleTitle: Hybrid Collaborative Learning Platform Design Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To construct the teaching mode of hybrid collaborative learning in cloud environment, a teaching interaction and management platform based on cloud computing is designed. Combined with the services and characteristics of cloud computing, we propose the overall framework of virtual teaching system. Then the key technologies of the main function modules are discussed by means of sequence diagram, program code and database design, and the specific implementation process is also provided. During the implementation of big data analysis, MapReduce strategy is improved, teaching resources are integrated, and the deep integration of online and offline teaching is realized. The system test results show that it realizes the functions of learning resources, testing, user management, communication and interaction, and improves the storage capacity and computing performance of the massive teaching resource data storage model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Massage Chair Control System Based on Human Machine Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of single performance and low intelligence of traditional massage chairs, this paper proposes an intelligent massage chair control method based on human machine interface This method takes PLC as the core component and adopts human machine interface as the intelligent control method. The system can be upgraded according to user and market needs. At the same time, it can enhance the experience and comfort of massage. The simulation results show that the system has the characteristics of stable operation and high precision, and also can improve the competitiveness of products, which has a strong practical significance.

articleTitle: Studying the Usability of Smart Bone Conduction Headphones from Multi-sensory User Experience
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To improve the usability and solve the usability evaluation issue of smart bone conduction headphones, a usability evaluation method based on multi-sensory user experience is proposed. By categorizing the sensory factors of bone conduction headphones into vision, tactile and hearing, combining their influence on design elements, a multilevel usability evaluation system for smart bone conduction headphones subject to multi-sensory factors is built using texts of sensory intentions. Through the analytic hierarchy process (AHP), the weight and priority sequence of each usability index subject to multi-sensory factors are calculated. Sample bone conduction Bluetooth headphones are selected to assess the usability from the tactile factor, providing an effective basis for design iteration. This method can effectively evaluate the usability of products subject to multi-sensory factors and accurately find out the problem for design optimization.

articleTitle: IP Network Multicast Technology and Application Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: IP network multicast technology effectively solves the problems of unicast and broadcast in point-to-multipoint applications, saves network bandwidth and reduces network load, and is widely used in multimedia conferences, video-ondemand, and IPTV fields. This paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of unicast, broadcast and multicast, introduces the basic architecture, service model and IP address mapping relationship of multicast, summarizes the operation mechanism of group membership management, compares and analyzes the working modes of the two multicast routing protocols, and finally Based on eNSP, the enterprise network multicast video stream is simulated and realized, which provides a good reference for the research and application of multicast technology.

articleTitle: A Simulation Scheme of Direct Drive Motor Motion Control Based on Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to explore the motion law of direct drive motor more intuitively and deeply, the dynamic model combined with PID is used to simulate the plane parallel motion platform. Firstly, the mathematical model of synchronous direct drive motor is established in DQ synchronous rotating coordinate system, and the simulation principle of motor control based on dynamic model is studied. On this basis, through the theoretical analysis of the motion trajectory system based on direct drive motor, a cascade PID model + feedforward compensation method is proposed to suppress the excess torque, and a three closed-loop parallel feedback control plus robust compensation structure is also adopted. The results of simulation experiments using Matlab/Simulink toolbox show that this scheme improves the accuracy of the simulation of the motor following the predetermined trajectory, which effectively reduces the position tracking error, and ensures the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: 5G communication optimization algorithm of mobile isolation and treatment system for epidemic prevention of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: At this stage, under the severe background of the epidemic globalization, the mobile isolation system plays an important role in the prevention of the epidemic and timely blocking the transmission source and timely isolation. In order to improve the efficiency of 5g communication signal transmission in the mobile isolation system and reduce the cost of service function chain, as well as the global search performance and local mining ability of the system. This paper proposes an improved sparrow search algorithm based on Multi Strategy signal fusion based on sparrow search algorithm (SSA). The optimization algorithm expands the global exploration scope, avoids the uncertainty of the algorithm caused by the randomness of the initial population, and improves the ability of avoiding local extremum and convergence speed of the algorithm. Experimental results show that the optimization algorithm improves the utilization of node computing resources and link resources. It can effectively reduce the deployment cost, help the algorithm jump out of local optimization and improve resource utilization.

articleTitle: A Remote Platform Identity Authentication Mechanism Based on Trusted Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To improve the security and reliability of remote terminals under trusted cloud platform, an identity authentication model based on DAA optimization is proposed. By introducing a trusted third-party CA, the scheme issues a cross domain DAA certificate to the trusted platform that needs cross domain authentication. Then, privacy CA isolation measures are taken to improve the security of the platform, so that the authentication scheme can be used for identity authentication when ordinary users log in to the host equipped with TPM chip. Finally, the trusted computing platform environment is established, and the performance load distribution and total performance load of each entity in the DAA protocol in the unit of machine cycle can be acquired through experimental analysis. The results show that the scheme can take into account the requirements of anonymity, time cost and cross domain authentication in the trusted cloud computing platform, and it is a useful supplement and extension to the existing theories of web service security.

articleTitle: 3D Visualization Enhancement of Art Image based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to enhance the 3d visualization of art images, this paper studies the 3D visual enhancement of fashion art images based on image virtual reality technology. The 3D feature detection and data acquisition of virtual scene are realized by the method of dark channel color scene parameter acquisition and information fusion. The distributed parameter model of fashion art image is established, the virtual reality scene of fashion art image is reconstructed, and the 3d filtering and feature analysis model is established. Feature analysis and RGB pixel reorganization are carried out by image information enhancement and parameter feedback compensation. Through exposure fusion and white balance control, the stereo visual enhancement of fashion art image is realized. The simulation results show that the research improves the reconstruction and recognition ability of fashion style art images, and the three-dimensional expression ability of art images is better, and the scene fidelity is higher.

articleTitle: Research on Acquisition and Translation Methods of English and Chinese Database Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: In order to expand the means of translation research by large-scale corpora, this paper proposes a scheme of English and Chinese corpus acquisition and translation under Hadoop platform by analysis on corpora and big data. Firstly, the construction process of Chinese-English translation corpus is provided from the perspective of big data. Then, combined with the demand analysis, the specific design and implementation methods of the key modules in the system, such as corpus preprocessing, crawler running configuration, sentence pair evaluation and database connection, are also put forward. Based on the analysis of the meaning characteristics of Chinese historical and cultural terms, the system tests the online translation functions of various mainstream translation websites. The results show that the quality of corpus data has been effectively improved, and the translation accuracy is better than that of similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Time Domain Interference Cancellation Module Based on LMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: This paper first explains the principle of adaptive filter, then introduces the composition of adaptive timedomain interference cancellation module, focuses on the analysis of LMS algorithm in adaptive filtering algorithm in communication system, and proposes an interference cancellation method using LMS algorithm in adaptive timedomain, and analyzes the simulation results of LMS algorithm under different conditions.

articleTitle: A Three-Step Underwater Moving Target Location Algorithm Based on FDOA
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: The position and velocity estimation of underwater moving targets is an important part of the application of underwater sensor networks. The commonly used fusion of time difference of arrival (TDOA) and angle of arrival (AOA) can only roughly estimate the target position, but also has some limitations for nonlinear problems. So in order to overcome the nonlinear problem and improve the accuracy of underwater target location.Based on TDOA and AOA, this paper adopts a three-step location method which combines frequency difference of arrival (FDOA).At the same time, the whale algorithm is used to optimize the measurement error based on the weighted least square method (Tswls). Finally, the experimental results show that compared with TDOA location method and tdoa/aoa hybrid location algorithm, this method is superior to the above methods in the accuracy and bias of position and velocity estimation.

articleTitle: Research on RBAC Based Role Access Control in Financial MIS
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications and Applications (ICWCAPP)
abstract: To solve the problem of inconsistent user rights management between client and server in traditional MIS, this paper takes the financial management system as an example, and studies the control technology based on role-based access. The scheme adopts RBAC mechanism to divide user roles into system roles and business roles, and combines with business logic to classify different users with the same role set into the same user group. Then an improved identity authentication model is established, and different role relationships and operation permission sets are defined. Through the application in multiple practical systems, the experimental analysis proves that RBAC based role access control improves the development efficiency and controllability of the system model, and it also ensures the safe operation of the financial management system.
